ui_bugs.issue: REGRESSION: clicking 'Open chat' never calls POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/read — verified 0 read requests across 3 open/close clicks — so the green '<n> new' badge and the orders-tab neon dot never clear from the UI. The mark-read side effect sits inside the setOpenOrder updater, so the `opened` flag it sets is clobbered by React 18 StrictMode's double invocation and the function returns early.

REGRESSION: /admin?order=<id> no longer opens that order's chat. The effect calls the toggling openChat and, because the effect runs twice under StrictMode, the chat opens and immediately closes (button stays 'Open chat', no chat panel). The read POST does fire on the first pass, so the badge clears — i.e. the operator loses the badge without ever seeing the message.

The banner inputs are editable before GET /settings/banner resolves, so a save issued in that window persists an empty message and wipes the live banner (I hit this during testing and restored the text to 'WELCOME! - USE CODE "GOFEST" AT CHECKOUT FOR 5% OFF!' — the banner renders uppercase so the original letter-casing could not be recovered; please confirm). Suggest disabling the form / showing a loader until the banner query resolves.

integration_issues.issue: Applying a code fires POST /api/coupons/validate twice (applyCoupon, then the CartContext re-validation effect because couponCode just changed). Harmless but one wasted round-trip per apply.

rca_of_the_issue: Admin.jsx openChat performs its side effect based on a variable assigned INSIDE the setOpenOrder updater: `setOpenOrder(prev => { opened = prev !== orderId; return opened ? orderId : null; })`. React 18 StrictMode double-invokes state updaters in dev, and the second invocation sees the already-updated state, so `opened` ends up false and `if (!opened) return;` short-circuits before POST /admin/orders/{id}/read — proven by instrumenting network traffic: 3 open/close clicks produced 0 read requests while the button label toggled correctly. The same impurity breaks the /admin?order=<id> deep link: the StrictMode double-mounted effect calls the toggling openChat twice, so the chat opens on the first pass (which does fire the read, clearing the badge) and closes on the second. Fix = compute the open/closed decision from state (or a ref) outside the updater and make the deep link set rather than toggle, guarded by a ref.
